description: The pie chart illustrates the distribution of various categories across a dataset, with each slice representing a different topic and its corresponding percentage. The largest segment is "AI/NLP Research," which accounts for 24.3% of the total, followed by "Econ. & Fin." at 18.4%. Other notable categories include "History" and "Game&Anime," both at 8.2%, and "Med & Health" and "Science," both at 6.7%. Smaller segments include "Daily Life" (7.1%), "Pet & Animal" (5.5%), "Law" (5.1%), "Business" (5.9%), "Geography" (2.7%), "Math" (1.2%), and "Game&Anime" (8.2%). The chart uses distinct colors for each category, with labels and percentages clearly indicated through lines connecting the slices to their respective text. The slices are arranged in a circular format, with the largest slice positioned at the top right and the smaller ones distributed clockwise around the chart.
